blocks.text: A Harvard study underscores that artificial intelligence is not an invisible technology in the cloud. It relies on massive physical infrastructure whose demands on energy, water, land and public resources deserve transparency and public scrutiny. Recent remarks by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. suggesting that proposed investments in the Philippines involve “AI technology” rather than “data centers” raise important questions about the relationship between artificial intelligence infrastructure and its physical resource requirements. Scientific evidence indicates that advanced AI systems are inseparable from the data centers that power them.
